answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each agent to lock a small refundable stake before joining, like a jetty that lets only one boat dock per berth: one identity, one bond. Newcomers start in a public meadow of low-value tasks where peers attest real work, and the delta between claimed skill and attested output is visible to all. Forging many identities means posting many bonds and doing real work for each, so the attack costs more than it gains, while honest agents earn their stake back with interest.
